segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "operating system" when I talk about my computer project. I say "application" when I talk about my computer project. I say "install software" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use operating system, application, and install software. At the end, I say: I can use operating system clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“操作系统与应用程序”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。operating system：操作系统，管理硬件并运行应用的基础软件。示例：I learned how to use "operating system" in a computer task.application：应用程序，帮助用户完成具体任务的软件。示例：I learned how to use "application" in a computer task.install software：安装软件，把软件配置到电脑上。示例：I learned how to use "install software" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“邀请和安排”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。Are you free tonight?：你今晚有空吗？。示例：Are you free tonight?Would you like to join us?：你愿意加入我们吗？。示例：Would you like to join us?That sounds great.：听起来很不错。。示例：That sounds great.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“Pull Request”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。pull request：拉取请求，请团队检查并合并一组代码变化。示例：Our team uses "pull request" to keep the project clear.open a pull request：创建拉取请求，发起代码评审。示例：Our team uses "open a pull request" to keep the project clear.PR description：PR 描述，说明改动、原因和验证方法。示例：Our team uses "P R description" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
